    """
    Transform rule: Flatten row-by-row, 3 blocks (rev/orig/rev), each value doubled horizontally

    # Flatten row by row
    flat = []
    for row in grid:
        flat.extend(row)
    
    n = len(flat)
    
    # First n rows are the "rev" block (reversed order)
